meta.name: eli5
meta.description: WHAT: Explains a codebase, a folder, a feature, a command or a pull request to someone who knows nothing about it, as a PR Lens canvas whose walkthrough builds the picture one part at a time. WHEN: /eli5 <thing>, or asked to explain code simply, for a beginner, a new hire, a non-engineer, or 'like I'm five'. KEYWORDS: eli5, explain like I'm five, explain simply, beginner, onboarding, walkthrough, diagram, PR Lens

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把看不懂的代码或改动,一步步讲成图解让人听懂
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果刚接手陌生代码库,或要给新人、非技术同事讲清代码
copy.tagline_en: Walk someone through unfamiliar code or a change, one part at a time, as a picture
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just inherited unfamiliar code or must explain code to newcomers

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把代码、文件夹、功能、命令或 PR 讲给完全不懂的人听:先给一句话答案,再逐张加图,最后呈现全貌。产物是一个 PR Lens 画布链接,你打开按播放观看;没有文字页面、列表或段落。
howto.when: 当你输入 “/eli5 <某个东西>”,或要求把代码讲得简单、讲给新手或非工程师听时触发。它依赖同仓库的 pr-lens 技能已安装,否则会先请你安装。

say.text: eli5 一下 src/checkout 这个文件夹
say.note: 会生成画布链接,一步步讲清这段代码

say.text: 把我刚提交的这个 PR 讲给新人听

say.note: 先给一句答案,再逐张放图

howto.what_en: After install, Claude explains code, a folder, a feature, a command or a PR to a total beginner. It writes a PR Lens canvas: one answer sentence, then pictures that grow a part at a time. You open the link and press play.
howto.when_en: Triggers on "/eli5 <thing>", or when asked to explain code simply for a beginner, a new hire or a non-engineer. Needs the pr-lens skill from the same repo installed.

say_en.note: Builds a canvas link that walks through it

say_en.text: Explain this PR simply, for a new hire
say_en.note: Grows the picture step by step
